summary: Consolidated the witness guard into one statement across the client entry points instead of tracing them one at a time. Checking each path shows the same shape: the command proposal, session proposal, read, configuration-change, snapshot request and leader-transfer entry points all test initialization and then reject a witness with the invalid-operation error before they create or queue any request state or offer anything to raft, and only afterwards touch their pending-proposal, pending-read, pending-configuration, pending-snapshot or leader-transfer object. Because the check uses the node's own witness configuration and returns synchronously, a witness caller gets an immediate error rather than a request left to a deadline, which also explains why the raft layer's unreported witness ReadIndex branch is defence in depth with no in-tree caller. Recorded as a single Fact with the two new source anchors for the snapshot and session-proposal paths; no conclusions or gaps changed.
